name: Parcel
author: kayleg
description: Parcel tracking in the Omarchy bar, backed by the parceltracker CLI: state-colored badge, shipment list with ETAs, and expandable checkpoint timelines.

barWidget.description: Lead parcel and ETA in the bar; popup with every shipment, checkpoint history, and carrier tracking links.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to re-read parceltracker's local state. Carrier API updates run on their own systemd timer.

schema.label: Show parcel label in the bar
schema.description: Show the lead parcel's name and ETA next to the icon on horizontal bars. Off = icon only.
